method: Extract page geometry, text, font sizes, image geometry and link annotations
Check full report strings and source URLs against compiled event JSON
Flag text outside page and character/image intersections over 25 percent of the smaller bounding box
Render every page with Poppler at 150 DPI for separate visual inspection
limitations: Bounding-box overlap is a heuristic; glyph ink can differ from PDF character boxes.
Full-width whitespace measurements exclude decorative rules and backgrounds.
Image presence and visible source attribution do not independently re-establish photo rights or subject identity.

observations: All five PDFs have one 319.955 x 179.917 mm page; this is the expected 320 x 180 mm layout within browser rounding.
The three columns, headings, comparisons and footer remain aligned. Korean glyphs render normally; no visible clipping, text overlap or image/text collisions were found.
ADEX, Eurosatory, DSEI and IDEX each show three distinct report photos. SAHA intentionally shows three missing-photo placeholders and embeds no photo.

Captions and source links are small but readable at the intended page size. The smallest measured size is 7.99 pt, corresponding to the 8 pt print CSS after PDF rounding; all referenced fonts are embedded.
The 32 mm photo row occupies less visual area than the available space allows. Large empty bands separate theme content from the comparison section.
IDEX has visible CC BY 4.0, photographer credits and WebP conversion notices. DSEI Patria has its credit and JPEG conversion notice.
Portrait AJBAN is especially small at approximately 24.08 mm wide; photo enlargement should help subject inspection without cropping.
SAHA has no visual evidence to enlarge; retaining its 32 mm placeholders is reasonable.
visualReview.improvement: Increase photo height to 45 mm while retaining contain fitting, current fonts, and 32 mm missing-photo placeholders.

recommendation.assessment: The baseline has enough measured whitespace for this change; final regenerated PDFs still require verification.
finalVerificationRequired: All image heights approximately 45 mm for four photo reports
No text outside page or overlap
All footers, Korean strings, source links, credits and change notices intact

observations: All five final PDFs were opened as Poppler-rendered page images and inspected in full.
Four photo reports now display three approximately 44.979 mm-high photos each. Subject details are easier to inspect, especially the portrait AJBAN image, and the large unused middle band is reduced.
Photos retain their aspect ratios and remain fully inside the page. No new crop, overlap, broken glyph or clipped paragraph is visible.
The smallest measured text is 7.99 pt, corresponding to 8 pt CSS after browser rounding. Body text is 10 pt, comparison text 9 pt, section headings 13.99 pt and the main message 19.99 pt.
ADEX has the narrowest remaining theme-to-comparison clearance at 10.47 mm; DSEI has 13.91 mm and Eurosatory/IDEX have 17.61 mm. These gaps preserve a clear separation.
The lowest character ends approximately 5.71 mm above the page edge in every report. Footer limitations and evidence links remain visible.
All current report summaries and three-theme labels match compiled data, including the shortened Eurosatory and IDEX copy.
IDEX license names, photographer credits and WebP notices remain visibly readable. DSEI Patria credit and JPEG conversion notice remain visible.
SAHA retains its three 32 mm placeholders and explicitly describes missing usable event photos. Its final PDF is byte-identical to the accepted baseline.
visualReview.remainingContentLimitation: SAHA has no displayable event photo in the approved dataset; this is disclosed in the report rather than filled with an unrelated image.
